topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I was astounded when I learned someone had chosen my art for their skin. It’s one thing to see your work in galleries, on walls, even in digital spaces, but to see it transformed into a tattoo—it’s a profound shift. The permanence of it, the personal connection it implies—these are aspects I hadn’t considered. It made me realize how deeply my art resonates, how it can become a part of someone’s identity. I started to think about the lines and colors, the emotions they must evoke to be so impactful. It’s a powerful reminder of the art’s journey beyond my studio, a journey into the hearts and bodies of those who truly connect with it.
